question: In March 2022, Bharat Biotech partnered with which country's bio-pharmaceutical firm Biofabri for TB vaccine?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Spain.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharat Biotech** is an Indian biotechnology company that specializes in **vaccine research and development.**
 
• **Biofabri **is a **Spanish bio-pharmaceutical firm** that focuses on the production and commercialization of vaccines and biologics.
 
• The partnership between Bharat Biotech and Biofabri aims to develop a new** tuberculosis (TB) vaccine, **which is a major public health concern globally.
 
• TB is a** bacterial infection** that primarily affects the lungs and is spread through the air when an infected person** coughs or sneezes**.
 
• It is one of the** top 10** causes of death worldwide.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Australia** has a **strong biotechnology sector** and is known for its research and development in vaccines.

 
 
• The country has several biopharmaceutical firms that specialize in vaccine development, such as **CSL Limited and Vaxine Pty Ltd.**
 
 
 
• The **United States** is a major player in the global biotechnology industry and has several biopharmaceutical firms that specialize in vaccine research and development, such as **Pfizer, Moderna, and Johnson** **Johnson.**
 
• **Canada **is home to several biopharmaceutical firms that specialize in vaccine development, such as **Medicago and VBI Vaccines**.
